name: @quevra/ops
description: Quevra workspace development and operations tooling

scripts.build: node --check src/index.js && node --check src/solonet-deploy.js && node --check src/generate-validator-keys.js && python3 -c "compile(open('src/sign-validator-registration.py').read(), 'src/sign-validator-registration.py', 'exec')"
scripts.test: node --test && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s test -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.typecheck: node --check src/index.js && node --check src/solonet-deploy.js && node --check src/generate-validator-keys.js && python3 -c "compile(open('src/sign-validator-registration.py').read(), 'src/sign-validator-registration.py', 'exec')"
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
